definitions.explanation: Failure to carry out a duty or obligation, especially one set out in a contract. Most often seen in the legal phrase {債務不履行|さいむふりこう} (default on an obligation).

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不履行|ふりこう}。
⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不履行|ふりこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{訴|うった}えられた→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: He was sued for non-performance of his duty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}わない→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不履行|ふりこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたる。
examples.english: Not paying the price constitutes a default on the obligation.

notes:
Formed from {不|ふ} (non-) + ⟦{履行|りこう}→履行：15293_rikou⟧ (performance, fulfillment). Mostly appears as the second half of a compound rather than standing alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{債務|さいむ}→債務：06578_saimu⟧{不履行|ふりこう}: default on an obligation
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧{不履行|ふりこう}: breach of contract
- {不履行|ふりこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into default

REGISTER:
A formal legal and business term. In everyday speech, people say ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}らない→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (not keep a promise) instead.
